speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twenty shillings on the table, and not a ribbon among them. I am counting before I bid you good morning. Noon is the bargain, and I am ahead of noon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Count them. I put them there to be counted.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Once. And again. Twenty. The quarter's chamber, and the clock has not been needed. Mark me, that is how a quarter day ought to feel.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The year has changed. The room has not improved.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Constancy is one of its virtues. You are not paying for a new stair. You are paying for the same stair, which has not fallen down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Write the receipt. I am not arguing with the stair.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am writing it in my husband's law-hand. That is the hand the parish trusts, and I can still make it. You will not have a flourish on a quarter-day paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can read a law-hand. I was not hoping for a flourish.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The firing sixpence ends today. The washing with it. Until Michaelmas. I am not collecting a sixpence for a room that will stand empty, and I am not starting the sixpences because a man looks cold in a doorway.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking you to start them. I leave in the morning after this one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the chamber. I'll not let it to a Lenten preacher. They burn more candle than you. You may be awake at all hours. You do not set fire to a house by it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it stays mine, and empty. I am glad of the not-letting. I am not asking it as a favour beyond what you have just said.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: As I am a Christian woman, a preacher in Lent is a candle with a sermon in it. You are only the candle. The room keeps.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Upstairs the book takes a new head. The year that began for the almanac in January begins for the law today. I shall rule a line and write 1595. Under it, the coffer, and nothing but the coffer.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then say the coffer. I can witness a sum. The pen is in my hand, which is as much witness as a quarter day wants.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: After your twenty, twenty-seven pounds and two shillings. The sixty shillings sewn in canvas are inside that count. I am taking the canvas out, and five pounds with it, for the road and for my father's shops. They go in the belt. Nineteen pounds and two shillings stay under both locks.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Say the part that stays. I like a remainder better than a journey.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nineteen pounds and two shillings. Both locks. The belt takes the canvas and the five pounds. Eight pounds, and none of it is for a shop this afternoon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: This afternoon is not your father's shop. This afternoon is my table. I have counted twenty twice. I will write twenty once. I will not write Stratford into a London receipt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The receipt is the chamber. Twenty shillings. The rest is my book, not yours.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we understand each other, and I charge no extra for understanding. The law-hand is dry enough. Take the paper. Lock the remainder before you start feeling generous. Generosity is how a locked box becomes a story.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will lock it before I feel anything about it. The five pounds have a use, and the use is not this afternoon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: This afternoon you may go to evening prayer, if you are the sort of man who goes. I shall know, because I shall be in the church. I am done with the money.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty, counted twice. I will not spend the belt in the hearing of a sermon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: See that you do not. I am putting the pen down. That is how you may know the asking is over.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The pen is down. The belt is not tied yet. That is upstairs, and it is still only the sums.
